accDeleteFlowText: Personal data is deleted irreversibly: the encryption keys are destroyed, so the data cannot be recovered. Signature hashes and the evidence chain are kept — this is needed for the integrity of contracts already concluded.
accDeleteWhatLink: What is deleted and what is kept

esicaStubTitle: Sign in with a government e-ID
esicaStubText: This is where identity verification through a government e-ID service (verification level 3) will go.
contactsEmptyText: A counterparty appears here automatically once you create a contract with them. Anyone can be saved from their reputation card.
portfolioEmptyText: Add your first work: a photo and a short description — they appear on your card.

phoneInvalid: Enter the number in international format: “+”, country code and number

portfolioDescriptionHint: Tell the story in detail: what you did, materials, timeline, what was hard — there is no length limit.
portfolioPhotosLimit: No more than 5 photos per work
formSpheresHint: Potential customers can find you by these fields. You can add up to 10.
hubFindableHint: Your profile shows up in search

workArea.cityEmptyHint: Not found? The directory only covers towns over 15,000 people. Pick a bigger area instead:
